title: A status change (promotion/demotion) moves the roster but leaves positions already open on the old book: ADA 6734 on bybit_1 (opened 2026-10-24, #21038 merged 2026-10-29 04:42Z). Define and build what happens to open positions on a book move (operator 2026-10-29: 'There shouldn't be three versions of this trade. There should be at most two'), and give strategy-status-guard/a runtime check a positions read, not only the roster
note: 2026-11-12 lane session_01AFoLuMm8mdmV1JgmwFHKEU: DEFINED in OPERATING-PLAN § 2 'Open positions on a book move' (promotion: the paper copy with a money/mirror sibling is closed on the paper book, per row if netted; sole copy runs out; demotion: money+mirror run out, keep open block new; retirement: runs out; at most 2 copies). Decision line sent to AM 2026-11-12 ~10:08Z. 2026-11-12 13:25Z: #25249 MERGED (0fc8e5b51; read-only scripts, no deploy needed: ops tool run from the repo). Observed from main 13:26Z: population 21 open positions (/api/bot/positions?include_paper=true), on_book 21, close_* 0, breaches 0. Remaining: #25251 (rule text, Tier 2 HELD, CI green, draft) for operator confirmation of the demotion half; follow-on rows STATUS-MOVE-AUTO-PAPER-CLOSE + POSITIONS-API-ORDER-PACKAGE-ID (queued).
